name: Pyre Lash
textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {burn} Burn. Lose {loseHp} HP.
flavor:
A whip of pyre-smoke, drawn from the Spire's lowest hearth.
It costs no breath, only the Mana the flame was promised.

name: Conflagration
textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {burn} Burn to ALL enemies. Exhaust.
flavor:
The whole landing catches at once.
The Ashen Choir sang it down in four verses, and the fourth was never finished.

name: Forked Bolt
textTemplate: Deal {damage} Lightning damage. Apply {shock} Shock. Lose {loseHp} HP.
flavor: The bolt finds the iron in a man before he knows he carries it.

name: Stormcall
textTemplate: Deal {damage} Lightning damage to ALL enemies. Apply {shock} Shock to ALL enemies.
flavor:
Called from the broken lenses of the old Observatory.
The sky answered, and did not ask what it was answering.

upgrade.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage. Apply {chill} Chill.

flavor: One needle of the deep winter, thrown by a hand that stayed warm.

upgrade.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Gain {block} Block. Gain {regen} Regen.

flavor:

The Chapel's censor struck the word from the record. The word did not strike back.

upgrade.textTemplate: Apply {weak} Weak and {frail} Frail. Remove your Weak and Frail.

name: Open the Archive

Every catalogue the Astronomer sealed, open at once.
The reader pays in Mana and keeps what the pages give back.

flavor: The light restores the body and quiets the curses laid upon it.

name: Mind Lance
flavor: A sharpened certainty pierces the mind and leaves its next defense uncertain.

name: Cleansing Embers
textTemplate: Heal {heal} HP. Remove your Weak and Frail.
flavor: A controlled flame burns away what clings to the spirit.

name: Rooted Shelter
flavor: Stone and root answer either a studied pattern or a steadfast prayer.

name: Storm Blessing
flavor: A measured current steadies the hands and returns motion to weary limbs.

name: Rime Veil
flavor: A veil of cold turns aside the blow and numbs the hand that struck it.
